audience: QA labeling after dual privacy review trims the pool to 100 scan and 100 prompt cases
case_id_rule: Keep the synthetic case id. When promoting a surviving pool row into a reviewed manifest, rewrite eval_scan_001 to eval-scan-001 and eval_prompt_001 to eval-prompt-001. Never substitute meal_id or user_id.
do_not_copy_from_pool_csv: calories is a protein*4 + carbs*4 + fat*9 estimate from the latest nutrition row, not a label and not the fiber-aware backend formula
confidence is nutrition.confidence_score, not a reviewed truth
created_at, cuisine_type, origin_country, edit_count, and is_manually_edited stay on the restricted pool and are not fixture fields

manifest_fields_after_dual_review.reviewed_by: required non-empty reviewer id that is not a production user id
manifest_fields_after_dual_review.source_provenance: required short provenance with no meal id, user id, or URL

qa_fields.coverage_notes: optional non-identifying note about what is visible
qa_fields.expected_calories_kcal: [low, high], non-negative, high >= low; do not copy pool calories

expected_foods.quantity_g: [low, high] edible grams, or one positive number

qa_fields.expected_is_food: true when the stripped photo shows food; false for negatives
qa_fields.image_path: relative path to the stripped, re-encoded JPEG inside the manifest directory
qa_fields.language: en or vi, assigned from the stripped photo, not from users.language_code
qa_fields.split: development or held_out, frozen before any prompt tuning

rules: Food photos need at least one expected food and expected_calories_kcal
Non-food photos need expected_is_food false and no expected_foods
Label only what is visible or independently verified. Do not fill a typical recipe as visual truth
known micros include value; unknown and masked micros must not include value
A reviewed 100-case corpus is not complete until every food case has all five macros and all ten micro statuses

qa_fields.expected_calories_kcal: [low, high]; do not copy pool calories
qa_fields.language: en or vi, assigned from the scrubbed text
qa_fields.split: development or held_out, frozen before any prompt tuning
qa_fields.text: scrubbed meal text with names, phones, and places removed

rules: At least one expected item, and no more than 20
Each item needs aliases and quantity_g
known micros include value; unknown and masked micros must not include value
Do not paste production dish names until they have been scrubbed
